_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Octail's own, following black-mesa.json, the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence), the TF2 Classified wiki's Dedicated Linux server guide and LinuxGSM's tf2cserver settings (MIT licence), on Octail's source image. Team Fortress 2 Classified (formerly TF2 Classic, free on Steam since 2026-01-30) needs two anonymous SteamCMD apps: 232250 (the Team Fortress 2 Dedicated Server) in tf2/, whose files the mod loads with -tf_path, and 3557020 (the Team Fortress 2 Classified Dedicated Server) in the server folder; the 64-bit srcds_linux64 runs with -game tf2classified. Octail adds the team-fortress-2-classified tags, Source RCON on the game port with a generated password hidden from customers, the Players tab (source preset) and the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, a max players setting (-maxplayers), an optional Game Server Login Token (+sv_setsteamaccount only when one is set), start detection by the Steam ID line or the Steam connection line with the UDP game port as a fallback (ready after 60 s), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, the update before start (AUTO_UPDATE, on by default: the image updates app 3557020, the startup line updates the TF2 files in tf2/), an optional beta branch, a starter server.cfg, install sandbox defaults and resource hints sized to both installs, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download either server. The disk hint is 40 GB: by Steam's depot manifests (2026-10-16) TF2 is 15.5 GB installed and a 10.7 GB download, TF2 Classified 7.8 GB and 3.6 GB; SteamCMD stages each download next to its install before moving the files into place, so the TF2 step needs about 26 GB and the TF2 Classified step 27 GB (23.3 GB stay installed), and a 30 GB disk ran out on node1 (2026-10-13: SteamCMD's second run had no 250 MB left). The install checks the free space first and stops with "Not enough disk space" below 36 GB, and prints the free disk after each step. SteamCMD's own files, caches and download staging stay on the server's disk (HOME=/mnt/server), only its 3 MB archive passes through /tmp. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times per app: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"; the SteamCMD download times out and retries instead of hanging the install.
name: Team Fortress 2 Classified
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Team Fortress 2 Classified (formerly TF2 Classic) is a free Source mod built on Team Fortress 2: the Civilian, four-team modes, Domination and reworked weapons. Its dedicated server loads the Team Fortress 2 server's files.

startup_commands.Default: [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = 0 ] || ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container/tf2 +login anonymous +app_update 232250 +quit || echo "octail: could not update the TF2 files in tf2/; starting with the installed ones."; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=".:bin/linux64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" ./srcds_linux64 -game tf2classified -tf_path /home/container/tf2 -console -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} -maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" -strictportbind $( [ -z "${STEAM_ACC}" ] || printf %s "+sv_setsteamaccount ${STEAM_ACC}" )

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Team Fortress 2 Classified Dedicated Server (app 3557020) Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Based on the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence) and the TF2 Classified wiki's
# "Dedicated Linux server" guide (wiki.tf2classified.com).
#
# Variables
# SRCDS_APPID - 3557020 (Team Fortress 2 Classified Dedicated Server, anonymous)
# TF2_APPID - 232250 (Team Fortress 2 Dedicated Server, anonymous): TF2 Classified loads TF2's files (-tf_path)
# SRCDS_BETAID - an optional beta branch of TF2 Classified

## Both dedicated servers install anonymously
STEAM_USER=anonymous
TF2_APPID=232250

## Octail: SteamCMD refuses to start an app (state 0x202) when the free space is short of the install plus its
## download, which it stages next to the install (steamapps/downloading) before moving the files into place.
## Checked here first, with a clear message: TF2 (232250) is 15.5 GB installed and a 10.7 GB download, TF2 Classified (3557020)
## 7.8 GB installed and a 3.6 GB download (Steam's depot manifests, 2026-10-16): about 26 GB during the TF2 step,
## 27 GB during the TF2 Classified step, 23.3 GB installed. A 30 GB disk ran out on node1 (2026-10-13).
MIN_FREE_MB=36864
free_mb=$(df -Pm /mnt/server | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }')
if [[ -n "${free_mb}" && "${free_mb}" -lt "${MIN_FREE_MB}" ]]; then
    echo "Not enough disk space: the install needs at least ${MIN_FREE_MB} MB free on the server's disk and it has ${free_mb} MB. Ask for a disk of 40 GB, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

## download and install steamcmd (only the 3 MB archive goes through /tmp; SteamCMD itself, its caches and its
## download staging live on the server's disk: HOME=/mnt/server, force_install_dir under it)
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
## Octail: time out and retry instead of hanging the install when the download stalls
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Could not download SteamCMD; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps /mnt/server/tf2/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install the TF2 dedicated server into tf2/ (SteamCMD stages its download in tf2/steamapps, on the server disk)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server/tf2 +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update "${TF2_APPID}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish the TF2 files (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
echo "octail: free disk after the TF2 files: $(df -Pm /mnt/server | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }') MB"

## install TF2 Classified into the server folder
beta=()
[[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || beta=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${beta[@]}" validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
echo "octail: free disk after TF2 Classified: $(df -Pm /mnt/server | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }') MB"

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries (the server is 64-bit: srcds_linux64)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -d "/mnt/server/tf2/tf" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Team Fortress 2 dedicated server files (tf2/tf); try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/srcds_linux64" || ! -d "/mnt/server/tf2classified" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Team Fortress 2 Classified dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/srcds_linux64

## A server.cfg to start from; an existing one is kept
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/tf2classified/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/tf2classified/cfg
    printf '%s\n' 'hostname "Team Fortress 2 Classified server on Octail"' 'sv_password ""' 'sv_lan 0' > /mnt/server/tf2classified/cfg/server.cfg
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Team Fortress 2 Classified Dedicated Server (the install adds the Team Fortress 2 Dedicated Server, 232250, in tf2/).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The first map, for example ctf_2fort; any map of TF2 Classified (tf2classified/maps/) or TF2 works.

variables.name: Steam Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam Game Server Login Token (app id 3545060, the Team Fortress 2 Classified game) so the server keeps the same Steam ID and shows in the server list reliably. Generate one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Source RCON password. Octail generates one when the server is created, keeps it from customers and sends console commands over RCON.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: An optional Steam beta branch of TF2 Classified; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description: Check for a server update (TF2 Classified and the TF2 files) with SteamCMD at every start (1 on, 0 off).
